newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Uromed initial rating hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Uromed initial rating hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Parice Halbert on Tuesday issued an initial rating of hold for Uromed Corp, which makes products to treat female incontinence.

-- Uromed is seen as a pioneer in the field, but several factors must emerge to provide a catalyst for the stock to rise, Dain Bosworth said. Those include solid sales of the company's Reliance Insert and Miniguard Patch, which are designed specifically to treat urinary incontinence in women.
